measurements.name: uptake
measurements.expr: (((median(molecule_glucose, where=(cell==1)) / median(molecule_glucose, where=(cell==0))) + (median(molecule_glucose, where=(cell==1)) / median(molecule_H2O, where=(cell==0))) + (median(molecule_glucose, where=(cell==1)) / median(molecule_NH4Cl, where=(cell==0))) +  + (median(molecule_glucose, where=(cell==1)) / median(molecule_KH2PO4, where=(cell==0))) + (median(molecule_glucose, where=(cell==1)) / median(molecule_MgSO4, where=(cell==0))) + (median(molecule_glucose, where=(cell==1)) / median(molecule_NaCl, where=(cell==0))) + (median(molecule_glucose, where=(cell==1)) / median(molecule_CaCl2, where=(cell==0))) + (median(molecule_glucose, where=(cell==1)) / median(molecule_FeSO4, where=(cell==0))) + (median(molecule_glucose, where=(cell==1)) / median(molecule_ZnCl2, where=(cell==0))))) / 9

measurements.name: transport
measurements.expr: (((max(molecule_glucose, where=(cell==1)) - min(molecule_glucose, where=(cell==1))) + (max(molecule_H2O, where=(cell==1)) - min(molecule_H2O, where=(cell==1))) + (max(molecule_NH4Cl, where=(cell==1)) - min(molecule_NH4Cl, where=(cell==1))) + (max(molecule_KH2PO4, where=(cell==1)) - min(molecule_KH2PO4, where=(cell==1))) + (max(molecule_MgSO4, where=(cell==1)) - min(molecule_MgSO4, where=(cell==1))) + (max(molecule_NaCl, where=(cell==1)) - min(molecule_NaCl, where=(cell==1))) + (max(molecule_CaCl2, where=(cell==1)) - min(molecule_CaCl2, where=(cell==1))) + (max(molecule_FeSO4, where=(cell==1)) - min(molecule_FeSO4, where=(cell==1))) + (max(molecule_ZnCl2, where=(cell==1)) - min(molecule_ZnCl2, where=(cell==1))))) / 9
